camel_example: aliyun ndr DescribeProtoLogTotalCount --region cn-hangzhou --Site global --ToTime 1788395400000 --FromTime 1788393600000 --LogFilter '{"logicOp":"and","logFilterItems":[{"logField":"src_ip","op":"=","value":"192.0.2.10"}]}' --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Counts the number of protocol logs based on the specified time range, site, and filter conditions. This operation can be used together with DescribeProtoLogs. The FromTime, ToTime, Site, and LogFilter parameters of both operations must be consistent
description_zh: 统计指定时间范围、站点和过滤条件下的协议日志条数。可与 DescribeProtoLogs 配合使用；两个接口的 FromTime、ToTime、Site 和 LogFilter 应保持一致
name: DescribeProtoLogTotalCount

parameters.help_en: The log filter conditions, specified as a JSON string. The logicOp field can be and or or. The logFilterItems field is an array of conditions, where each item contains logField, op, and value, and value is a string. The logFilters field can nest condition groups of the same structure. If this parameter is not specified, no field filtering is applied. You can obtain the available fields and operators by calling the ListProtoLogSupportIndex operation
parameters.help_zh: 日志过滤条件，使用 JSON 字符串。logicOp 为 and 或 or；logFilterItems 为条件数组，每项包含 logField、op、value，value 使用字符串；logFilters 可嵌套同结构的条件组。不传时不附加字段过滤。可用字段和运算符通过 ListProtoLogSupportIndex 获取
parameters.name: log_filter

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query, which is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. If this parameter is not specified or is set to 0, the time 30 minutes before the current time is used. The value must not be later than the value of ToTime. Specify both the start and end times
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。不传或传 0 时，使用当前时间前 30 分钟；须不晚于 ToTime。建议同时传入开始和结束时间
parameters.name: from_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query, which is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. If this parameter is not specified or is set to 0, the current time is used. The value must not be earlier than the value of FromTime. If the values of FromTime and ToTime are the same, the system queries data within the time range from 1 second before ToTime to ToTime
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。不传或传 0 时，使用当前时间；须不早于 FromTime。当 FromTime 与 ToTime 相等时，系统按 ToTime 前 1 秒至 ToTime 的时间范围查询
parameters.name: to_time

parameters.help_en: The site for the log query. You can obtain the value from the Sites parameter returned by the DescribeDeliveryDestination operation. In multi-site scenarios, the specified valid site is used first. If no site is specified or the specified site is unavailable, the system automatically selects an available site. If only one site is available, that site is used. If no site is available, the LogDeliveryNotOpen error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 日志查询站点，可从 DescribeDeliveryDestination 返回的 Sites 中获取。多站点场景下优先使用有效的指定站点；未指定或指定站点不可用时，系统自动选择可用站点。仅有一个可用站点时使用该站点；无可用站点时返回 LogDeliveryNotOpen
parameters.name: site

Data.description_en: The statistics on the number of protocol logs
Data.description_zh: 协议日志数量统计结果

ProtoLogTotalCount.description_en: The number of protocol logs that meet the query conditions
ProtoLogTotalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的协议日志条数

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. This parameter is empty when the request is successful. The example shows a scenario where the query range is invalid
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；请求成功时为空。示例展示查询范围无效场景

Message.description_en: The message about the request result. This parameter describes the cause of the error when the request fails. The example shows a scenario where the query range is invalid
Message.description_zh: 请求结果信息；失败时用于说明错误原因。示例展示查询范围无效场景

RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次请求

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. A value of true indicates success, and a value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
